name: Telly
source:
There is nothing worth your gaze more than the big black box full of comedy, drama and the occasional commercial break. Telly was the star of the show for so many decades that any hint of a slip in their ratings is dusted off like so much static. Keep them in your sights and this sassy showman will give you back so much more.
Likes: Attention
Dislikes: Volume control
